profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Courier Heath

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
•Implementing new front-end and back-end features using React, Typescript, Python, GraphQL, and PostgreSQL
• Integrating third party software to projects including Braze and Healthgorilla as microservices to enhance existing products
• Developing a new product platform and writing scalable, maintainable code for new lines of business
• Mentoring and onboarding new engineers to bring them up to speed and start contributing effectively

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•Building, deploying, and maintaining RESTful APIs using NodeJS, Docker, Postgres, and Kubernetes for internal use
• Developing Javascript programs to automate team workflows to improve efficiency and reduce menial work, such as automatically troubleshooting and closing tickets
• Developing end to end workflow solutions using NodeJS and Selenium WebDriver to automate work procedures

positions.title: Implementation Intern
positions.description:
• Created custom Javascript, jQuery, and HTML/CSS code for specific client front end needs such as cookies handling, visual changes, GREF compliance, and UTM parameters
 • Integrated Splash software and API with third party software including Salesforce and Beamery using iPaaS solutions such as Zapier and Informatica 
• Developed Python automation scripts with Selenium WebDriver to assist with upgrading and testing all existing Splash web pages in a product rollout over the course of three months

positions.title: Student at CUNY Tech Prep
positions.description:
• Selected for a full stack JavaScript training program, as one of 122 students out of 400+ applicants 
• Learned industry best practices for implementation, development, and design of full stack applications such as MVC, version control with Git, test driven development, AGILE & Scrum with Slack, along with in-demand technologies including Express, Node JS, and PostgreSQL

positions.title: NOC Engineer
positions.description:
• Performed data analysis on periods of client transactions to verify integrity of recorded data and find trends in eFX trading using Python with Pandas and SQL 
 • Maintained and troubleshot problems with  the company’s network and systems to ensure high availability between clients and liquidity providers such as Bloomberg and Bank of America

positions.title: Tech Intern
positions.locationName: P.S. K721 Brooklyn Occupational Training Center
positions.description:
• Re-imaged computers, updated and maintained inventory, and installed new software and hardware to ensure up-to-date technology for teachers and staff 
 • Troubleshot and resolved general issues and provided maintenance regarding networks, connectivity, hardware and software failures for school faculty
